sections.A: Baazu ki haddi ke upar wale hisse ka fracture aksar barhi umar mein osteoporosis ke saath girne se hota hai. Hansli ka fracture naujawanon mein khel ya gaari ki chot se zyada hota hai.
sections.B: Dard, sujan aur neel (jo baazu ke neeche tak phail sakta hai), aur baazu hilane se inkaar.
sections.C: Kaise gire, kya girne se pehle chakkar ya behoshi hui, aur doctor ne fracture aur ijazat wali movement ke baare mein kya kaha.
sections.D: Imaging report aur surgeon ka protocol dekhein. Nabz, haath ka rang aur axillary nerve ka sensation zaroor check karein.
sections.E: Shuru ke fracture phase mein soft tissue tests nahi karte. Baad mein rotator cuff ki halat dekhte hain.
sections.F: Kandhe ka utarna aur rotator cuff tear isi jaise lag sakte hain.
sections.G: Thanda peela haath, kamzor nabz, naya sunn-pan ya kamzori, ya barhta dard: foran refer.
sections.H: Fracture ki qism aur ijazat wali movement confirm karein, nerves aur khoon check karein, phir phase ke mutabiq rehab.
sections.I: Ijazat ho to halki passive range; haddi judne ke baad dheere dheere glides.
sections.J: Pehle din se haath dabana aur kohni-kalai ki movement, phir pendulum, assisted elevation aur dheere dheere taaqat. Hamesha surgeon ki hidayat.
sections.K: Shuru mein dard ke liye barf, baad mein stretching se pehle garmi.
sections.L: Phase 1 hifazat aur dard control, haath aur kohni chalti rahein. Phir range, phir taaqat aur roz ke kaam.
sections.M: Range, dard, QuickDASH ya Oxford score aur apna kaam khud karne ki salahiyat.
sections.N: Sawaal hal karein. Yaad rakhein: kohni aur haath pehle din se hilayein, woh jaldi akadte hain.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
